{{Top}}
[[File:XwingTargetingComp.png|thumb|right|Targeting computer on a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing fighter]]]]
The '''IN-344-B "Sightline" holographic imaging system''' was a key component in several [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computers]] manufactured by [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]], including the [[ANq 3.6 sensor computer/Legends|ANq 3.6 tracking computer]] found on [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]], [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighters]], and [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]].

The device simplified what could be seen by the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], making computer-assisted targeting a much easier task. However, it also possessed a chance of causing a near-miss, as evidenced by [[Garven Dreis/Legends|Garven Dreis]], the "[[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]]" of [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], firing off two [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] at the thermal exhaust port during the [[Trench Run Defense|trench run]] upon getting a lock, but instead hit some yards away from the exhaust port.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>
